paper_title: Probing the Blue Axion with Cosmic Optical Background Anisotropies
notes: Paper constrains the 'blue axion' (mass 5-25 eV) two-photon coupling g_agamma via HST COB anisotropy measurements at 606 nm (CDM scenario). Primary figures (Figs. 1,6,11) present the DECAY RATE / LIFETIME (Gamma_a->gg in s^-1) vs mass; Fig. 9 presents the equivalent bound directly in g_agamma [GeV^-1]. I emit g_agamma values. Well-anchored text points: best-fit at ma=10 eV gives g=1.24e-11 GeV^-1; note-added point ma=4.2 eV gives g=2.33e-11 GeV^-1 (Gamma=3.03e-25 s^-1). Other points (5,15,20,25 eV) are approximate read-offs of the Fig. 9 CDM curve, hence moderate confidence. Conversion relation Gamma=g^2 m^3/(64 pi). The 336/438 nm curves are projections (not extracted here); 606 nm is a real observed constraint.
